source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of prominent cultural and natural features in the landscape.

listed_values.label: Cairn
listed_values.definition: A mound of stones, usually conical or pyramidal, raised as a landmark or to designate a point of importance in surveying.

listed_values.label: Cemetery
listed_values.definition: A site and associated structures devoted to the burial of the dead.

listed_values.label: Chimney
listed_values.definition: A vertical structure containing a passage or flue for discharging smoke and gases of combustion.

listed_values.label: Dish Aerial
listed_values.definition: A parabolic aerial for the receipt and transmission of high frequency radio signals.

listed_values.label: Flagstaff
listed_values.definition: A staff or pole on which flags are raised.

listed_values.label: Flare Stack
listed_values.definition: A tall structure used for burning-off waste oil or gas.

listed_values.label: Mast
listed_values.definition: A relatively tall structure usually held vertical by guy lines.

listed_values.label: Windsock
listed_values.definition: A tapered fabric sleeve mounted so as to catch and swing with the wind, thus indicating the wind direction.

listed_values.label: Monument
listed_values.definition: A structure erected and/or maintained as a memorial to a person and/or event.

listed_values.label: Column/Pillar
listed_values.definition: A cylindrical or slightly tapering body of considerably greater length than diameter erected vertically.

listed_values.label: Memorial Plaque
listed_values.definition: A slab of metal, usually ornamented, erected as a memorial to a person or event.

listed_values.label: Obelisk
listed_values.definition: A tapering shaft usually of stone or concrete, square or rectangular in section, with a pyramidal apex.

listed_values.label: Statue
listed_values.definition: A representation of a living being, sculptured, moulded, or cast in a variety of materials (for example: marble, metal, or plaster).

listed_values.label: Cross
listed_values.definition: A monument, or other structure in form of a cross.

listed_values.label: Dome
listed_values.definition: A landmark comprising a hemispherical or spheroidal shaped structure.

listed_values.label: Radar Scanner
listed_values.definition: A device used for directing a radar beam through a search pattern.

listed_values.label: Tower
listed_values.definition: A relatively tall, narrow structure that may either stand alone or may form part of another structure.

listed_values.label: Windmill
listed_values.definition: A system of vanes attached to a tower and driven by wind (excluding wind turbines).

listed_values.label: Spire/Minaret
listed_values.definition: A tall conical or pyramid-shaped structure often built on the roof or tower of a building, especially a church or mosque.

listed_values.label: Large Rock or Boulder on Land
listed_values.definition: An isolated rocky formation or a single large stone.

listed_values.label: Triangulation Mark
listed_values.definition: A recoverable point on the earth, whose geographic position has been determined by angular methods with geodetic instruments. A triangulation point is a selected point, which has been marked with a station mark, or it is a conspicuous natural or artificial feature.

listed_values.label: Boundary Mark
listed_values.definition: A marker identifying the location of a surveyed boundary line.

listed_values.label: Observation Wheel
listed_values.definition: Wheels with passenger cars mounted external to the rim and independently rotated by electric motors.

listed_values.label: Torii
listed_values.definition: A form of decorative gateway or portal, consisting of two upright wooden posts connected at the top by two horizontal crosspieces, commonly found at the entrance to Shinto temples.

listed_values.label: Bridge
listed_values.definition: A structure erected over a depression or an obstacle such as a body of water, railroad, etc., to provide a roadway for vehicles or pedestrians.

listed_values.label: Dam
listed_values.definition: A barrier to check or confine anything in motion; particularly one constructed to hold back water and raise its level to form a reservoir, or to prevent flooding.

source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of an aid to navigation which signifies some special purpose.

listed_values.label: Firing Danger Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a firing danger area, usually at sea.

listed_values.label: Target Mark
listed_values.definition: Any object toward which something is directed. The distinctive marking or instrumentation of a ground point to aid its identification on a photograph.

listed_values.label: Marker Ship Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark marking the position of a ship which is used as a target during some military exercise.

listed_values.label: Degaussing Range Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a degaussing range.

listed_values.label: Barge Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark of relevance to barges.

listed_values.label: Cable Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_values.label: Spoil Ground Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the limit of a spoil ground.

listed_values.label: Outfall Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.

listed_values.label: ODAS
listed_values.definition: Ocean Data Acquisition System.

listed_values.label: Recording Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to record data for scientific purposes.

listed_values.label: Seaplane Anchorage Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a seaplane anchorage.

listed_values.label: Recreation Zone Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a recreation zone.

listed_values.label: Mooring Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a mooring or moorings.

listed_values.label: LANBY
listed_values.definition: A large buoy designed to take the place of a lightship where construction of an offshore light station is not feasible.

listed_values.label: Leading Mark
listed_values.definition: Aids to navigation or other indicators so located as to indicate the path to be followed. Leading marks identify a leading line when they are in transit.

listed_values.label: Measured Distance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.

listed_values.label: Notice Mark
listed_values.definition: A notice board or sign indicating information to the mariner.

listed_values.label: TSS Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a Traffic Separation Scheme.

listed_values.label: Anchoring Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an anchoring prohibited area.

listed_values.label: Berthing Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Overtaking Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that overtaking is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Two-Way Traffic Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a one-way route.

listed_values.label: Reduced Wake Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.

listed_values.label: Speed Limit Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a speed limit applies.

listed_values.label: Stop Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.

listed_values.label: General Warning Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the mark.

listed_values.label: Sound Ship's Siren Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.

listed_values.label: Restricted Vertical Clearance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.

listed_values.label: Maximum Vessel's Draught Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the maximum draught of vessel permitted.

listed_values.label: Restricted Horizontal Clearance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.

listed_values.label: Strong Current Warning Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark warning of strong currents.

listed_values.label: Berthing Permitted Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is allowed.

listed_values.label: Overhead Power Cable Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an overhead power cable.

listed_values.label: Channel Edge Gradient Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.

listed_values.label: Telephone Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the presence of a telephone.

listed_values.label: Ferry Crossing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route; often used with a 'sound ship's siren' mark.

listed_values.label: Pipeline Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_values.label: Anchorage Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an anchorage area.

listed_values.label: Clearing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a clearing line.

listed_values.label: Control Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

listed_values.label: Diving Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that diving may take place in the vicinity.

listed_values.label: Refuge Beacon
listed_values.definition: A mark providing or indicating a place of safety.

listed_values.label: Foul Ground Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a foul ground.

listed_values.label: Yachting Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark installed for use by yachtsmen.

listed_values.label: Heliport Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an area where helicopters may land.

listed_values.label: GNSS Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a location at which a GNSS position has been accurately determined.

listed_values.label: Seaplane Landing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an area where seaplanes land.

listed_values.label: Entry Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that entry is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Work in Progress Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

listed_values.label: Mark With Unknown Purpose
listed_values.definition: A mark whose detailed characteristics are unknown.

listed_values.label: Wellhead Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.

listed_values.label: Channel Separation Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.

listed_values.label: Marine Farm Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm/culture.

listed_values.label: Artificial Reef Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.

listed_values.label: Ice Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark, used year round, that may be submerged when ice passes through the area.

listed_values.label: Nature Reserve Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to define the boundary of a nature reserve.

listed_values.label: Fish Aggregating Device
listed_values.definition: A fish aggregating (or aggregation) device (FAD) is a man-made object used to attract ocean going pelagic fish such as marlin, tuna and mahi-mahi (dolphin fish). They usually consist of buoys or floats tethered to the ocean floor with concrete blocks or adrift.

listed_values.label: Wreck Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a wreck.

listed_values.label: Customs Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a customs checkpoint.

listed_values.label: Causeway Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a causeway.

listed_values.label: Wave Recorder
listed_values.definition: A surface following buoy used to measure wave activity.

source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of different light types.

listed_values.label: Leading Light
listed_values.definition: A light associated with other lights so as to form a leading line to be followed.

listed_values.label: Aero Light
listed_values.definition: An aero light is established for aeronautical navigation and may be of higher power than marine lights and visible from well offshore.

listed_values.label: Flood Light
listed_values.definition: A broad beam light used to illuminate a structure or area.

listed_values.label: Strip Light
listed_values.definition: A light whose source has a linear form generally horizontal, which can reach a length of several metres.

listed_values.label: Subsidiary Light
listed_values.definition: A light placed on or near the support of a main light and having a special use in navigation.

listed_values.label: Spotlight
listed_values.definition: A powerful light focused so as to illuminate a small area.

listed_values.label: Front

listed_values.label: Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly shorter than the total duration of darkness and all the appearances of light are of equal duration.

listed_values.label: Long-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 50 flashes per minutes but less than 80 flashes per minutes. It may be: - Continuous quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated. - Group quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Very Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 80 flashes per minute but less than 160 flashes per minute. It may be:- Continuous very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated.- Group very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Continuous Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are regularly repeated at a rate of not less than 160 flashes per minute.

listed_values.label: Isophased
listed_values.definition: A light with all durations of light and darkness equal.

listed_values.label: Occulting
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and all the eclipses are of equal duration. It may be:  - Single-occulting: An occulting light in which an eclipse is regularly repeated.  - Group-occulting: An occulting light in which a group of two or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.  - Composite group-occulting: An occulting light in which a sequence of groups of one or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated, and the groups comprise different numbers of eclipses.

listed_values.label: Interrupted Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A light in which the ultra quick flashes (160 or more per minute) are interrupted at regular intervals by eclipses of long duration.

listed_values.label: Morse
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which appearances of light of two clearly different durations are grouped to represent a character or characters in the Morse code.

listed_values.label: Fixed and Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Flash and Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a flashing light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Occulting and Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which an occulting light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Fixed and Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Occulting Alternating
listed_values.definition: An alternating light in which the total duration of light in each period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and in which the intervals of darkness (occultations) are all of equal duration.

listed_values.label: Long-Flash Alternating
listed_values.definition: An alternating single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Flash Alternating
listed_values.definition: An alternating rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly shorter than the total duration of darkness and all the appearances of light are of equal duration.

listed_values.label: Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_values.label: Very Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of very quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_values.label: Ultra Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of ultra quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_values.label: Alternating

listed_values.label: Fixed and Alternating Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity and different colour.

source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of prominent cultural and natural features in the landscape.

listed_values.label: Cairn
listed_values.definition: A mound of stones, usually conical or pyramidal, raised as a landmark or to designate a point of importance in surveying.

listed_values.label: Cemetery
listed_values.definition: A site and associated structures devoted to the burial of the dead.

listed_values.label: Chimney
listed_values.definition: A vertical structure containing a passage or flue for discharging smoke and gases of combustion.

listed_values.label: Dish Aerial
listed_values.definition: A parabolic aerial for the receipt and transmission of high frequency radio signals.

listed_values.label: Flagstaff
listed_values.definition: A staff or pole on which flags are raised.

listed_values.label: Flare Stack
listed_values.definition: A tall structure used for burning-off waste oil or gas.

listed_values.label: Mast
listed_values.definition: A relatively tall structure usually held vertical by guy lines.

listed_values.label: Windsock
listed_values.definition: A tapered fabric sleeve mounted so as to catch and swing with the wind, thus indicating the wind direction.

listed_values.label: Monument
listed_values.definition: A structure erected and/or maintained as a memorial to a person and/or event.

listed_values.label: Column/Pillar
listed_values.definition: A cylindrical or slightly tapering body of considerably greater length than diameter erected vertically.

listed_values.label: Memorial Plaque
listed_values.definition: A slab of metal, usually ornamented, erected as a memorial to a person or event.

listed_values.label: Obelisk
listed_values.definition: A tapering shaft usually of stone or concrete, square or rectangular in section, with a pyramidal apex.

listed_values.label: Statue
listed_values.definition: A representation of a living being, sculptured, moulded, or cast in a variety of materials (for example: marble, metal, or plaster).

listed_values.label: Cross
listed_values.definition: A monument, or other structure in form of a cross.

listed_values.label: Dome
listed_values.definition: A landmark comprising a hemispherical or spheroidal shaped structure.

listed_values.label: Radar Scanner
listed_values.definition: A device used for directing a radar beam through a search pattern.

listed_values.label: Tower
listed_values.definition: A relatively tall, narrow structure that may either stand alone or may form part of another structure.

listed_values.label: Windmill
listed_values.definition: A system of vanes attached to a tower and driven by wind (excluding wind turbines).

listed_values.label: Spire/Minaret
listed_values.definition: A tall conical or pyramid-shaped structure often built on the roof or tower of a building, especially a church or mosque.

listed_values.label: Large Rock or Boulder on Land
listed_values.definition: An isolated rocky formation or a single large stone.

listed_values.label: Triangulation Mark
listed_values.definition: A recoverable point on the earth, whose geographic position has been determined by angular methods with geodetic instruments. A triangulation point is a selected point, which has been marked with a station mark, or it is a conspicuous natural or artificial feature.

listed_values.label: Boundary Mark
listed_values.definition: A marker identifying the location of a surveyed boundary line.

listed_values.label: Observation Wheel
listed_values.definition: Wheels with passenger cars mounted external to the rim and independently rotated by electric motors.

listed_values.label: Torii
listed_values.definition: A form of decorative gateway or portal, consisting of two upright wooden posts connected at the top by two horizontal crosspieces, commonly found at the entrance to Shinto temples.

listed_values.label: Bridge
listed_values.definition: A structure erected over a depression or an obstacle such as a body of water, railroad, etc., to provide a roadway for vehicles or pedestrians.

listed_values.label: Dam
listed_values.definition: A barrier to check or confine anything in motion; particularly one constructed to hold back water and raise its level to form a reservoir, or to prevent flooding.

source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of an aid to navigation which signifies some special purpose.

listed_values.label: Firing Danger Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a firing danger area, usually at sea.

listed_values.label: Target Mark
listed_values.definition: Any object toward which something is directed. The distinctive marking or instrumentation of a ground point to aid its identification on a photograph.

listed_values.label: Marker Ship Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark marking the position of a ship which is used as a target during some military exercise.

listed_values.label: Degaussing Range Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a degaussing range.

listed_values.label: Barge Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark of relevance to barges.

listed_values.label: Cable Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_values.label: Spoil Ground Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the limit of a spoil ground.

listed_values.label: Outfall Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.

listed_values.label: ODAS
listed_values.definition: Ocean Data Acquisition System.

listed_values.label: Recording Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to record data for scientific purposes.

listed_values.label: Seaplane Anchorage Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a seaplane anchorage.

listed_values.label: Recreation Zone Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a recreation zone.

listed_values.label: Mooring Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a mooring or moorings.

listed_values.label: LANBY
listed_values.definition: A large buoy designed to take the place of a lightship where construction of an offshore light station is not feasible.

listed_values.label: Leading Mark
listed_values.definition: Aids to navigation or other indicators so located as to indicate the path to be followed. Leading marks identify a leading line when they are in transit.

listed_values.label: Measured Distance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.

listed_values.label: Notice Mark
listed_values.definition: A notice board or sign indicating information to the mariner.

listed_values.label: TSS Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a Traffic Separation Scheme.

listed_values.label: Anchoring Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an anchoring prohibited area.

listed_values.label: Berthing Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Overtaking Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that overtaking is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Two-Way Traffic Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a one-way route.

listed_values.label: Reduced Wake Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.

listed_values.label: Speed Limit Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a speed limit applies.

listed_values.label: Stop Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.

listed_values.label: General Warning Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the mark.

listed_values.label: Sound Ship's Siren Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.

listed_values.label: Restricted Vertical Clearance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.

listed_values.label: Maximum Vessel's Draught Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the maximum draught of vessel permitted.

listed_values.label: Restricted Horizontal Clearance Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.

listed_values.label: Strong Current Warning Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark warning of strong currents.

listed_values.label: Berthing Permitted Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is allowed.

listed_values.label: Overhead Power Cable Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an overhead power cable.

listed_values.label: Channel Edge Gradient Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.

listed_values.label: Telephone Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the presence of a telephone.

listed_values.label: Ferry Crossing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route; often used with a 'sound ship's siren' mark.

listed_values.label: Pipeline Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_values.label: Anchorage Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an anchorage area.

listed_values.label: Clearing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate a clearing line.

listed_values.label: Control Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

listed_values.label: Diving Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that diving may take place in the vicinity.

listed_values.label: Refuge Beacon
listed_values.definition: A mark providing or indicating a place of safety.

listed_values.label: Foul Ground Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a foul ground.

listed_values.label: Yachting Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark installed for use by yachtsmen.

listed_values.label: Heliport Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an area where helicopters may land.

listed_values.label: GNSS Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a location at which a GNSS position has been accurately determined.

listed_values.label: Seaplane Landing Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating an area where seaplanes land.

listed_values.label: Entry Prohibited Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that entry is prohibited.

listed_values.label: Work in Progress Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

listed_values.label: Mark With Unknown Purpose
listed_values.definition: A mark whose detailed characteristics are unknown.

listed_values.label: Wellhead Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.

listed_values.label: Channel Separation Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.

listed_values.label: Marine Farm Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm/culture.

listed_values.label: Artificial Reef Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.

listed_values.label: Ice Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark, used year round, that may be submerged when ice passes through the area.

listed_values.label: Nature Reserve Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to define the boundary of a nature reserve.

listed_values.label: Fish Aggregating Device
listed_values.definition: A fish aggregating (or aggregation) device (FAD) is a man-made object used to attract ocean going pelagic fish such as marlin, tuna and mahi-mahi (dolphin fish). They usually consist of buoys or floats tethered to the ocean floor with concrete blocks or adrift.

listed_values.label: Wreck Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a wreck.

listed_values.label: Customs Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a customs checkpoint.

listed_values.label: Causeway Mark
listed_values.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a causeway.

listed_values.label: Wave Recorder
listed_values.definition: A surface following buoy used to measure wave activity.

source_backed_claims.definition: A regular repeated design containing more than one colour.

listed_values.label: Horizontal Stripes
listed_values.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented horizontally.

listed_values.label: Vertical Stripes
listed_values.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented vertically.

listed_values.label: Diagonal Stripes
listed_values.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented diagonally (that is, not horizontally or vertically).

listed_values.label: Squared
listed_values.definition: Often referred to as checker plate, where alternate colours are used to create squares similar to a chess or draught board. The pattern may be straight or diagonal.

listed_values.label: Stripes (Direction Unknown)
listed_values.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented in an unknown direction.

listed_values.label: Border Stripe
listed_values.definition: A band or stripe of colour which is displayed around the outer edge of the feature, which may also form a border to an inner pattern or plain colour.

listed_values.label: Under Construction
listed_values.definition: Being built but not yet capable of function.

listed_values.label: Ruined
listed_values.definition: A structure in a decayed or deteriorated condition resulting from neglect or disuse, or a damaged structure in need of repair.

listed_values.label: Under Reclamation
listed_values.definition: An area of the sea, a lake or the navigable part of a river that is being reclaimed as land, usually by the dumping of earth and other material.

listed_values.label: Wingless
listed_values.definition: A windmill or wind turbine from which the vanes or turbine blades are missing.

listed_values.label: Planned Construction
listed_values.definition: Detailed planning has been completed but construction has not been initiated.

source_backed_claims.definition: A specific role that describes a feature.

listed_values.label: Harbour-Masters Office
listed_values.definition: A local official who has charge of mooring and berthing of vessels, collecting harbour fees, etc.

listed_values.label: Customs Office
listed_values.definition: Serves as a government office where customs duties are collected, the flow of goods are regulated and restrictions enforced, and shipments or vehicles are cleared for entering or leaving a country.

listed_values.label: Health Office
listed_values.definition: The office which is charged with the administration of health laws and sanitary inspections.

listed_values.label: Hospital
listed_values.definition: An institution or establishment providing medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.

listed_values.label: Post Office
listed_values.definition: The public department, agency or organisation responsible primarily for the collection, transmission and distribution of mail.

listed_values.label: Hotel
listed_values.definition: An establishment, especially of a comfortable or luxurious kind, where paying visitors are provided with accommodation, meals and other services.

listed_values.label: Railway Station
listed_values.definition: A building with platforms where trains arrive, load, discharge and depart.

listed_values.label: Police Station
listed_values.definition: The headquarters of a local police force and that is where those under arrest are first charged.

listed_values.label: Water-Police Station
listed_values.definition: The headquarters of a local water-police force.

listed_values.label: Pilot Office
listed_values.definition: The office or headquarters of pilots; the place where the services of a pilot may be obtained.

listed_values.label: Pilot Lookout
listed_values.definition: A distinctive structure or place on shore from which personnel keep watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_values.label: Bank Office
listed_values.definition: An office for custody, deposit, loan, exchange or issue of money.

listed_values.label: Headquarters for District Control
listed_values.definition: The quarters of an executive officer (director, manager, etc.) with responsibility for an administrative area.

listed_values.label: Transit Shed/Warehouse
listed_values.definition: A building or part of a building for storage of wares or goods.

listed_values.label: Factory
listed_values.definition: A building or buildings with equipment for manufacturing; a workshop.

listed_values.label: Power Station
listed_values.definition: A stationary plant containing apparatus for large scale conversion of some form of energy (such as hydraulic, steam, chemical or nuclear energy) into electrical energy.

listed_values.label: Administrative
listed_values.definition: A building for the management of affairs.

listed_values.label: Educational Facility
listed_values.definition: An establishment for teaching and learning (for example school, college, university, etc).

listed_values.label: Church
listed_values.definition: A building for public Christian worship.

listed_values.label: Chapel
listed_values.definition: A place for Christian worship other than a parish, cathedral or church, especially one attached to a private house or institution.

listed_values.label: Temple
listed_values.definition: A building for public Jewish worship.

listed_values.label: Pagoda
listed_values.definition: A Hindu or Buddhist temple or sacred building.

listed_values.label: Shinto Shrine
listed_values.definition: A building for public Shinto worship.

listed_values.label: Buddhist Temple
listed_values.definition: A building for public Buddhist worship.

listed_values.label: Mosque
listed_values.definition: A Muslim place of worship.

listed_values.label: Marabout
listed_values.definition: A shrine marking the burial place of a Muslim holy man.

listed_values.label: Lookout
listed_values.definition: Keeping a watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_values.label: Communication
listed_values.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving electronic communication signals.

listed_values.label: Television
listed_values.definition: A system for reproducing on a screen visual images transmitted (usually with sound) by radio signals.

listed_values.label: Radio
listed_values.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving radio-frequency electromagnetic waves as a means of communication.

listed_values.label: Radar
listed_values.definition: A method, system or technique of using beamed, reflected, and timed radio waves for detecting, locating, or tracking objects, and for measuring altitudes.

listed_values.label: Light Support
listed_values.definition: A structure serving as a support for one or more lights.

listed_values.label: Microwave
listed_values.definition: Broadcasting and receiving signals using microwaves.

listed_values.label: Cooling
listed_values.definition: Generation of chilled liquid and/or gas for cooling purposes.

listed_values.label: Observation
listed_values.definition: A place from which the surroundings can be observed but at which a watch is not habitually maintained.

listed_values.label: Timeball
listed_values.definition: A visual time signal in the form of a ball.

listed_values.label: Clock
listed_values.definition: Instrument for measuring time and recording hours.

listed_values.label: Control
listed_values.definition: Used to control the flow of traffic within a specified range of an installation.

listed_values.label: Airship Mooring
listed_values.definition: Equipment or structure to secure an airship.

listed_values.label: Stadium
listed_values.definition: An arena for holding and viewing events.

listed_values.label: Bus Station
listed_values.definition: A building where buses and coaches regularly stop to take on and/or let off passengers, especially for long-distance travel.

listed_values.label: Sea Rescue Control
listed_values.definition: A unit responsible for promoting efficient organization of search and rescue services and for coordinating the conduct of search and rescue operations within a search and rescue region.

listed_values.label: Observatory
listed_values.definition: A building designed and equipped for making observations of astronomical, meteorological, or other natural phenomena.

listed_values.label: Ore Crusher
listed_values.definition: A building or structure used to crush ore.

listed_values.label: Boathouse
listed_values.definition: A building or shed, usually built partly over water, for sheltering a boat or boats.

listed_values.label: Pumping Station
listed_values.definition: A facility to move solids, liquids or gases by means of pressure or suction.

source_backed_claims.definition: The building's primary construction material.

listed_values.label: Masonry
listed_values.definition: Constructed of stones or bricks, usually quarried, shaped, and mortared.

listed_values.label: Concreted
listed_values.definition: Constructed of concrete, a material made of sand and gravel that is united by cement into a hardened mass used for roads, foundations, etc.

listed_values.label: Loose Boulders
listed_values.definition: Constructed from large stones or blocks of concrete, often placed loosely for protection against waves or water turbulence.

listed_values.label: Hard Surfaced
listed_values.definition: Constructed with a surface of hard material, usually a term applied to roads surfaced with asphalt or concrete.

listed_values.label: Unsurfaced
listed_values.definition: Constructed with no extra protection, usually a term applied to roads not surfaced with a hard material.

listed_values.label: Wooden
listed_values.definition: Constructed from wood.

listed_values.label: Metal
listed_values.definition: Constructed from metal.

listed_values.label: Glass Reinforced Plastic
listed_values.definition: Constructed from a plastic material strengthened with fibres of glass.

listed_values.label: Latticed
listed_values.definition: A structure of crossed wooden or metal strips usually arranged to form a diagonal pattern of open spaces between the strips.

listed_values.label: Glass
listed_values.definition: [1] Any artificial or natural substance having similar properties and composition, as fused borax, obsidian, or the like.   [2] Something made of such a substance, as a windowpane.

listed_values.label: Permanent
listed_values.definition: Intended to last or function indefinitely.

listed_values.label: Occasional
listed_values.definition: Acting on special occasions; happening irregularly.

listed_values.label: Recommended
listed_values.definition: Presented as worthy of confidence, acceptance, use, etc.

listed_values.label: Not in Use
listed_values.definition: Use has ceased, but the facility still exists intact; disused.

listed_values.label: Periodic/Intermittent
listed_values.definition: Recurring at intervals.

listed_values.label: Reserved
listed_values.definition: Set apart for some specific use.

listed_values.label: Temporary
listed_values.definition: Meant to last only for a time.

listed_values.label: Private
listed_values.definition: Administered by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.

listed_values.label: Mandatory
listed_values.definition: Compulsory; enforced.

listed_values.label: Extinguished
listed_values.definition: No longer lit.

listed_values.label: Illuminated
listed_values.definition: Lit by flood lights, strip lights, etc.

listed_values.label: Historic
listed_values.definition: Famous in history; of historical interest.

listed_values.label: Public
listed_values.definition: Belonging to, available to, used or shared by, the community as a whole and not restricted to private use.

listed_values.label: Synchronized
listed_values.definition: Occur at a time, coincide in point of time, be contemporary or simultaneous.

listed_values.label: Watched
listed_values.definition: Looked at or observed over a period of time especially so as to be aware of any movement or change.

listed_values.label: Unwatched
listed_values.definition: Usually automatic in operation, without any permanently-stationed personnel to superintend it.

listed_values.label: Existence Doubtful
listed_values.definition: A feature that has been reported but has not been definitely determined to exist.

listed_values.label: Buoyed
listed_values.definition: Marked by buoys.

listed_values.label: Prominent
listed_values.definition: Objects which are easily identifiable, but do not justify being classed as conspicuous.

listed_values.label: High-Rise Building
listed_values.definition: A building having many storeys.

listed_values.label: Pyramid
listed_values.definition: A polyhedron of which one face is a polygon of any number of sides, and the other faces are triangles with a common vertex.

listed_values.label: Cylindrical
listed_values.definition: Shaped like a cylinder, which is a solid geometrical figure generated by straight lines fixed in direction and describing with one of its points a closed curve, especially a circle.

listed_values.label: Spherical
listed_values.definition: Shaped like a sphere, which is a body the surface of which is at all points equidistant from the centre.

listed_values.label: Cubic
listed_values.definition: A shape the sides of which are six equal squares; a regular hexahedron.

source_backed_claims.definition: Classification of different light types.

listed_values.label: Leading Light
listed_values.definition: A light associated with other lights so as to form a leading line to be followed.

listed_values.label: Aero Light
listed_values.definition: An aero light is established for aeronautical navigation and may be of higher power than marine lights and visible from well offshore.

listed_values.label: Flood Light
listed_values.definition: A broad beam light used to illuminate a structure or area.

listed_values.label: Strip Light
listed_values.definition: A light whose source has a linear form generally horizontal, which can reach a length of several metres.

listed_values.label: Subsidiary Light
listed_values.definition: A light placed on or near the support of a main light and having a special use in navigation.

listed_values.label: Spotlight
listed_values.definition: A powerful light focused so as to illuminate a small area.

listed_values.label: Front
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Rear
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Lower
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Upper
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Emergency
listed_values.definition: A light available as a backup to a main light which will be illuminated should the main light fail.

listed_values.label: Bearing Light
listed_values.definition: A light which enables its approximate bearing to be obtained without the use of a compass.

listed_values.label: Horizontally Disposed
listed_values.definition: A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed horizontally.

listed_values.label: Diagonal Stripes

listed_values.label: Squared
listed_values.definition: Often referred to as checker plate, where alternate colours are used to create squares similar to a chess or draught board. The pattern may be straight or diagonal.

listed_values.label: Stripes (Direction Unknown)

listed_values.label: Border Stripe
listed_values.definition: A band or stripe of colour which is displayed around the outer edge of the feature, which may also form a border to an inner pattern or plain colour.

source_backed_claims.definition: A specific role that describes a feature.

listed_values.label: Harbour-Masters Office
listed_values.definition: A local official who has charge of mooring and berthing of vessels, collecting harbour fees, etc.

listed_values.label: Customs Office
listed_values.definition: Serves as a government office where customs duties are collected, the flow of goods are regulated and restrictions enforced, and shipments or vehicles are cleared for entering or leaving a country.

listed_values.label: Health Office
listed_values.definition: The office which is charged with the administration of health laws and sanitary inspections.

listed_values.label: Hospital
listed_values.definition: An institution or establishment providing medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.

listed_values.label: Post Office
listed_values.definition: The public department, agency or organisation responsible primarily for the collection, transmission and distribution of mail.

listed_values.label: Hotel
listed_values.definition: An establishment, especially of a comfortable or luxurious kind, where paying visitors are provided with accommodation, meals and other services.

listed_values.label: Railway Station
listed_values.definition: A building with platforms where trains arrive, load, discharge and depart.

listed_values.label: Police Station
listed_values.definition: The headquarters of a local police force and that is where those under arrest are first charged.

listed_values.label: Water-Police Station
listed_values.definition: The headquarters of a local water-police force.

listed_values.label: Pilot Office
listed_values.definition: The office or headquarters of pilots; the place where the services of a pilot may be obtained.

listed_values.label: Pilot Lookout
listed_values.definition: A distinctive structure or place on shore from which personnel keep watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_values.label: Bank Office
listed_values.definition: An office for custody, deposit, loan, exchange or issue of money.

listed_values.label: Headquarters for District Control
listed_values.definition: The quarters of an executive officer (director, manager, etc.) with responsibility for an administrative area.

listed_values.label: Transit Shed/Warehouse
listed_values.definition: A building or part of a building for storage of wares or goods.

listed_values.label: Factory
listed_values.definition: A building or buildings with equipment for manufacturing; a workshop.

listed_values.label: Power Station
listed_values.definition: A stationary plant containing apparatus for large scale conversion of some form of energy (such as hydraulic, steam, chemical or nuclear energy) into electrical energy.

listed_values.label: Administrative
listed_values.definition: A building for the management of affairs.

listed_values.label: Educational Facility
listed_values.definition: An establishment for teaching and learning (for example school, college, university, etc).

listed_values.label: Church
listed_values.definition: A building for public Christian worship.

listed_values.label: Chapel
listed_values.definition: A place for Christian worship other than a parish, cathedral or church, especially one attached to a private house or institution.

listed_values.label: Temple
listed_values.definition: A building for public Jewish worship.

listed_values.label: Pagoda
listed_values.definition: A Hindu or Buddhist temple or sacred building.

listed_values.label: Shinto Shrine
listed_values.definition: A building for public Shinto worship.

listed_values.label: Buddhist Temple
listed_values.definition: A building for public Buddhist worship.

listed_values.label: Mosque
listed_values.definition: A Muslim place of worship.

listed_values.label: Marabout
listed_values.definition: A shrine marking the burial place of a Muslim holy man.

listed_values.label: Lookout
listed_values.definition: Keeping a watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_values.label: Communication
listed_values.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving electronic communication signals.

listed_values.label: Television
listed_values.definition: A system for reproducing on a screen visual images transmitted (usually with sound) by radio signals.

listed_values.label: Radio
listed_values.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving radio-frequency electromagnetic waves as a means of communication.

listed_values.label: Radar
listed_values.definition: A method, system or technique of using beamed, reflected, and timed radio waves for detecting, locating, or tracking objects, and for measuring altitudes.

listed_values.label: Light Support
listed_values.definition: A structure serving as a support for one or more lights.

listed_values.label: Microwave
listed_values.definition: Broadcasting and receiving signals using microwaves.

listed_values.label: Cooling
listed_values.definition: Generation of chilled liquid and/or gas for cooling purposes.

listed_values.label: Observation
listed_values.definition: A place from which the surroundings can be observed but at which a watch is not habitually maintained.

listed_values.label: Timeball
listed_values.definition: A visual time signal in the form of a ball.

listed_values.label: Clock
listed_values.definition: Instrument for measuring time and recording hours.

listed_values.label: Control
listed_values.definition: Used to control the flow of traffic within a specified range of an installation.

listed_values.label: Airship Mooring
listed_values.definition: Equipment or structure to secure an airship.

listed_values.label: Stadium
listed_values.definition: An arena for holding and viewing events.

listed_values.label: Bus Station
listed_values.definition: A building where buses and coaches regularly stop to take on and/or let off passengers, especially for long-distance travel.

listed_values.label: Sea Rescue Control
listed_values.definition: A unit responsible for promoting efficient organization of search and rescue services and for coordinating the conduct of search and rescue operations within a search and rescue region.

listed_values.label: Observatory
listed_values.definition: A building designed and equipped for making observations of astronomical, meteorological, or other natural phenomena.

listed_values.label: Ore Crusher
listed_values.definition: A building or structure used to crush ore.

listed_values.label: Boathouse
listed_values.definition: A building or shed, usually built partly over water, for sheltering a boat or boats.

listed_values.label: Pumping Station
listed_values.definition: A facility to move solids, liquids or gases by means of pressure or suction.

listed_values.label: Glass Reinforced Plastic

listed_values.label: Latticed

listed_values.definition: Presented as worthy of confidence, acceptance, use, etc.

listed_values.definition: Recurring at intervals.

listed_values.label: Reserved
listed_values.definition: Set apart for some specific use.

listed_values.label: Temporary
listed_values.definition: Meant to last only for a time.

listed_values.label: Private
listed_values.definition: Administered by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.

listed_values.label: Mandatory
listed_values.definition: Compulsory; enforced.

listed_values.label: Extinguished
listed_values.definition: No longer lit.

listed_values.label: Illuminated
listed_values.definition: Lit by flood lights, strip lights, etc.

listed_values.label: Historic

listed_values.label: Public

listed_values.label: Synchronized
listed_values.definition: Occur at a time, coincide in point of time, be contemporary or simultaneous.

listed_values.label: Watched
listed_values.definition: Looked at or observed over a period of time especially so as to be aware of any movement or change.

listed_values.label: Unwatched
listed_values.definition: Usually automatic in operation, without any permanently-stationed personnel to superintend it.

listed_values.label: Leading Light
listed_values.definition: A light associated with other lights so as to form a leading line to be followed.

listed_values.label: Aero Light
listed_values.definition: An aero light is established for aeronautical navigation and may be of higher power than marine lights and visible from well offshore.

listed_values.label: Flood Light
listed_values.definition: A broad beam light used to illuminate a structure or area.

listed_values.label: Strip Light
listed_values.definition: A light whose source has a linear form generally horizontal, which can reach a length of several metres.

listed_values.label: Subsidiary Light
listed_values.definition: A light placed on or near the support of a main light and having a special use in navigation.

listed_values.label: Spotlight
listed_values.definition: A powerful light focused so as to illuminate a small area.

listed_values.label: Front
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Rear
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Lower
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Upper
listed_values.definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

listed_values.label: Emergency
listed_values.definition: A light available as a backup to a main light which will be illuminated should the main light fail.

listed_values.label: Bearing Light
listed_values.definition: A light which enables its approximate bearing to be obtained without the use of a compass.

listed_values.label: Horizontally Disposed
listed_values.definition: A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed horizontally.

listed_values.label: Vertically Disposed
listed_values.definition: A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed vertically.

listed_values.definition: Non-marine lights with a higher power than marine lights and visible from well off shore (often 'Aero' lights).

listed_values.label: Low Intensity
listed_values.definition: Non-marine lights with lower power than marine lights.

listed_values.label: Faint
listed_values.definition: A decrease in the apparent intensity of a light which may occur in the case of partial obstructions.

listed_values.label: Intensified
listed_values.definition: A light in a sector is intensified (that is, has longer range than other sectors).

listed_values.label: Unintensified
listed_values.definition: A light in a sector is unintensified (that is, has shorter range than other sectors).

listed_values.label: Visibility Deliberately Restricted
listed_values.definition: A light sector is deliberately reduced in intensity, for example to reduce its effect on a built-up area.

listed_values.label: Obscured
listed_values.definition: Said of the arc of a light sector designated by its limiting bearings in which the light is not visible from seaward.

listed_values.label: Partially Obscured
listed_values.definition: This value specifies that parts of the sector are obscured.

listed_values.label: Visible in Line of Range
listed_values.definition: Lights that must be in line to be visible.

source_backed_claims.definition: The reference level used for expressing the vertical measurements of points on the earth's surface. Also called datum level, reference plane, levelling datum, datum for sounding reduction, datum for heights.

listed_values.label: Mean Low Water Springs
listed_values.definition: The average height of the low waters of spring tides. This level is used as a tidal datum in some areas.

listed_values.label: Mean Lower Low Water Springs
listed_values.definition: The average height of lower low water springs at a place.

listed_values.label: Mean Sea Level
listed_values.definition: The average height of the surface of the sea at a tide station for all stages of the tide over a 19-year period, usually determined from hourly height readings measured from a fixed predetermined reference level.

listed_values.label: Lowest Low Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest tide observed at a place, or somewhat lower.

listed_values.label: Mean Low Water
listed_values.definition: The average height of all low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_values.label: Lowest Low Water Springs
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest water level observed at a place at spring tides during a period of time shorter than 19 years.

listed_values.label: Approximate Mean Low Water Springs
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water Springs (MLWS).

listed_values.label: Indian Spring Low Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary tidal datum approximating the level of the mean of the lower low water at spring tides. It was first used in waters surrounding India.

listed_values.label: Low Water Springs
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean low water springs (MLWS).

listed_values.label: Approximate Lowest Astronomical Tide
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT).

listed_values.label: Nearly Lowest Low Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level approximating the lowest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the Indian Spring Low Water (ISLW).

listed_values.label: Mean Lower Low Water
listed_values.definition: The average height of the lower low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_values.label: Low Water
listed_values.definition: The lowest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

listed_values.label: Approximate Mean Low Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water (MLW).

listed_values.label: Approximate Mean Lower Low Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW).

listed_values.label: Mean High Water
listed_values.definition: The average height of all high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_values.label: Mean High Water Springs
listed_values.definition: The average height of the high waters of spring tides.

listed_values.label: High Water
listed_values.definition: The highest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

listed_values.label: Approximate Mean Sea Level
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Sea Level (MSL).

listed_values.label: High Water Springs
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean high water springs (MHWS).

listed_values.label: Mean Higher High Water
listed_values.definition: The average height of higher high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_values.label: Equinoctial Spring Low Water
listed_values.definition: The level of low water springs near the time of an equinox.

listed_values.label: Lowest Astronomical Tide
listed_values.definition: The lowest tide level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

listed_values.label: Local Datum
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary datum defined by a local harbour authority, from which levels and tidal heights are measured by this authority.

listed_values.label: International Great Lakes Datum 1985
listed_values.definition: A vertical reference system with its zero based on the mean water level at Rimouski/Pointe-au-Père, Quebec, over the period 1970 to 1988.

listed_values.label: Mean Water Level
listed_values.definition: The average of all hourly water levels over the available period of record.

listed_values.label: Lower Low Water Large Tide
listed_values.definition: The average of the lowest low waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

listed_values.label: Higher High Water Large Tide
listed_values.definition: The average of the highest high waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

listed_values.label: Nearly Highest High Water
listed_values.definition: An arbitrary level approximating the highest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the high water springs.

listed_values.label: Highest Astronomical Tide
listed_values.definition: The highest tidal level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

listed_values.label: Baltic Sea Chart Datum 2000
listed_values.definition: The datum refers to each Baltic country's realization of the European Vertical Reference System (EVRS) with land-uplift epoch 2000, which is connected to the Normaal Amsterdams Peil (NAP).

listed_values.definition: The upper part of the body above the water-line, or the greater part of the superstructure, has approximately the shape or the appearance of a pointed cone with the point upwards.

listed_values.label: Can
listed_values.definition: The upper part of the body above the water-line, or the greater part of the superstructure, has the shape of a cylinder, or a truncated cone that approximates to a cylinder, with a flat end uppermost.

listed_values.label: Spherical
listed_values.definition: Shaped like a sphere, which is a body the surface of which is at all points equidistant from the centre.

listed_values.label: Pillar
listed_values.definition: The upper part of the body above the water-line, or the greater part of the superstructure is a narrow vertical structure, pillar or lattice tower.

listed_values.label: Spar
listed_values.definition: The upper part of the body above the water-line, or the greater part of the superstructure, has the form of a pole, or of a very long cylinder, floating upright.

listed_values.label: Barrel
listed_values.definition: The upper part of the body above the water-line, or the greater part of the superstructure, has the form of a barrel or cylinder floating horizontally.

listed_values.label: Superbuoy
listed_values.definition: A very large buoy designed to carry a signal light of high luminous intensity at a high elevation.

listed_values.label: Ice Buoy
listed_values.definition: A specially constructed shuttle shaped buoy which is used in ice conditions.

listed_values.label: Fixed
listed_values.definition: A signal light that shows continuously, in any given direction, with constant luminous intensity and colour.

listed_values.label: Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly shorter than the total duration of darkness and all the appearances of light are of equal duration.

listed_values.label: Long-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 50 flashes per minutes but less than 80 flashes per minutes. It may be: - Continuous quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated. - Group quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Very Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 80 flashes per minute but less than 160 flashes per minute. It may be:- Continuous very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated.- Group very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_values.label: Continuous Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are regularly repeated at a rate of not less than 160 flashes per minute.

listed_values.label: Isophased
listed_values.definition: A light with all durations of light and darkness equal.

listed_values.label: Occulting
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and all the eclipses are of equal duration. It may be:  - Single-occulting: An occulting light in which an eclipse is regularly repeated.  - Group-occulting: An occulting light in which a group of two or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.  - Composite group-occulting: An occulting light in which a sequence of groups of one or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated, and the groups comprise different numbers of eclipses.

listed_values.label: Interrupted Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_values.definition: A light in which the ultra quick flashes (160 or more per minute) are interrupted at regular intervals by eclipses of long duration.

listed_values.label: Morse
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which appearances of light of two clearly different durations are grouped to represent a character or characters in the Morse code.

listed_values.label: Fixed and Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Flash and Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a flashing light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Occulting and Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which an occulting light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Fixed and Long-Flash
listed_values.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_values.label: Occulting Alternating
listed_values.definition: An alternating light in which the total duration of light in each period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and in which the intervals of darkness (occultations) are all of equal duration.

listed_values.definition: An alternating single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.
